discription: A simple pulse wave synth with ADSR envelope and pulse width modulation, providing a richer harmonic content than a sine wave.
code: { arg out=0, freq=440, amp=0.1, gate=1, pulseWidth=0.5, pwModFreq=2; var sig; var env = EnvGen.ar(Env.adsr(0.01, 0.2, 0.7, 0.5, curve: -4), gate: gate, doneAction: 2); var pwMod = LFSaw.ar(pwModFreq).range(0.1, 0.9); sig = Pulse.ar(freq, pwMod) * amp * env; Out.ar(out, sig ! 2); }
